Name: Body big eyes and bare feet
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size]

This female farmer's body has big eyes, and walks barefoot, and why not, to be able to walk in the grass barefoot, I liked the idea a lot and because my female farmer is a tree hugging naturist.
Then I wanted a swimsuit that could change color, with a bra without straps with a smaller bust, briefs a little less bulky and less vivid skin color.
In this body you can change the color of the swimsuit by simply changing the color of the pants or skirt, automatically you will have the swimsuit in the color you choose.
It seems to be compatible with all Fashion Sense clothes.

Enjoy. <3

Known bug:
There is a small graphic bug if you choose white hair color, I don't know why it does it and at the moment I have not been able to fix it yet.

Installation:
Unzip it and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder, to uninstall it simply delete this mod.

[color=#00ffff][size=5]Thank you all for your support! It encourages me to create and share new mods. <3[/size][/color]
